    Gemini said

    = =

    On Linux, your terminal history, AI tool configs= , and agent session databases (VS Code & Cursor) are stored across hidd= en dotfiles (~/.ba= sh_history, ~/.config/, ~/.claude/) and local SQLite/JSON logs.

    Here is an automated bash script to aggregate, package, and compress ev= ery single session, log, and AI conversation history on your machine into a= single tarball before you format.

    Step 1: R= un the One-Click Aggregator Script

    Open your= Linux terminal and paste this complete execution script:

    <= !---->
    Bash
    mkdir -p ~/AI_and_Terminal_Backup
cd ~/AI_and_Terminal_Backup

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D 1. Backing up Shell Histories =3D=3D=3D"
cp ~/.bash_history ./bash_history.txt 2>/dev/null
cp ~/.zsh_history ./zsh_history.txt 2>/dev/null
cp ~/.bash_profile ./bash_profile.bak 2>/dev/null
cp ~/.bashrc ./bashrc.bak 2>/dev/null
cp ~/.zshrc ./zshrc.bak 2>/dev/null

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D 2. Backing up Cursor IDE Chats & Composer Histories =3D=3D=3D"
mkdir -p ./Cursor_Data
# Cursor stores SQLite DBs (state.vscdb) conta=
ining all chat bubbles & composer history here
cp -r ~/.config/Cursor/User/globalStorage ./Cursor_Data/ 2>/dev/null
cp -r ~/.config/Cursor/User/workspaceStorage ./Cursor_Data/ 2>/dev/null

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D 3. Backing up VS Code Workspace & AI Agent Data =3D=3D=3D"
mkdir -p ./VSCode_Data
cp -r ~/.config/Code/User/globalStorage ./VSCode_Data/ 2>/dev/null
cp -r ~/.config/Code/User/workspaceStorage ./VSCode_Data/ 2>/dev/null

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D 4. Backing up CLI AI Agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, etc.) =3D=3D=
=3D"
mkdir -p ./CLI_Agents
cp -r ~/.claude ./CLI_Agents/ 2>/dev/null
cp -r ~/.gemini ./CLI_Agents/ 2>/dev/null
cp -r ~/.config/gemini-cli ./CLI_Agents/ 2>/dev/null
cp -r ~/.local/share/gemini ./CLI_Agen=
ts/ 2>/dev/null

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D 5. Scanning for .env files & custom project logs =3D=3D=3D"
# Finds all .log and .env files in your home d=
irectory (excluding node_modules)
find ~ -maxdepth 4 -not -path '*/.*' -no=
t -path '*/node_modules/*' \( -name "*.log" -o -name ".env*" \) -exec cp --parents =
{} ./ \; 2>/dev/null

echo "=3D=
=3D=3D COMPLETE =3D=3D=3D"

    Bash
    <= /gem-icon-button>
    cd ~
tar -czvf AI_Terminal_Full_Backup_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz AI_and_Terminal_Ba=
ckup/

    This creates a fi= le named AI_Termin= al_Full_Backup_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz in your home folder.
